sources.snippet: A hybrid deep learning project that combines Computer Vision and Natural Language Processing to generate descriptive captions for images. This repository implements multiple architectures—from custom CNN-RNN models with Attention to state-of-the-art Transformers—and integrates Object Detection for enhanced context.

sources.title: Deep Learning Approaches on Image Captioning: A Review
sources.snippet: Image captioning is a research area of immense importance, aiming to generate natural language descriptions for visual content in the form of still images.
